sanskrit: labdhabodhodayā nandaṃ vande saṃsthānamātmanaḥgṛhyate pañcabhistaśca cakṣurādi bhirindriyaiḥtatpralīnaṃ bhavettasya yasya sarvaṃ pralīyatetadāgama mayādbhraṃśa bhayāt sṛṣṭī kṛte mayāyastuto na tatāssanti niścityai tacchamaṃ vrajetnābudbudo na peṣaṃ vāna śarīre kvacit sthitamkṣāya?kṣayivināśāntaṃ taśca naivopalabhyatepṛthak sarvaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ kvaśarīre mana sthitamna ca sā vastuto yuktyā kasya cedvā vabhāsateguṇī yadi bhavet kaścid bhavanti vahavo guṇāḥcañcalaṃ manaso rūpaṃ niścityai tannibodhayetayatnena nirodhoyamasmābhirupadiśyateanyasyā grahaṇāccittaṃ svātmanyeva praśāmyatitadāśraya vaśāccittaṃ tasmin kṣīṇe praśāmyatiekāgraṃ bhāvayet tāvad yāvallīnaṃ nirodhakṛtvilīnānnāsmaret paścādātmabhāvopavṛṃhitāḥ || 16 |||grahaṇā deva pūrvoyamidānīṃ saṃpradṛśyatep. 246b) pararāgātmahāniḥ syāddveṣasyo pakṣayāttathābudhavat sarvarāgī syāt sarvaduṣṭaśca bhairavaḥpralīnendriya vṛttistu kevalā bhyudayodayaḥnistabdhendriya vṛttestu nibodhaḥ saṃprajāyatedhyāyate vā kimasyāntaḥ pratyante kevalaṃ bhavetviṣayā grahaṇāt sarva śirodhaḥ saṃprajāyatenissaṅkalpa manovṛtteḥ paramātmā prakāśatevicāryaivaṃ prayatnena nirāgāre praśāmyati

sanskrit: na ca citte sthito vāyurna vāyau cittamāsthitampūrayettā yathā śaktirbhavet pūrṇo nirāśrayaḥp. 147b) punastasyānu sandhānāt kṣaṇāt kaivalyamāpnuyātsuniścita mateḥ kṣipraṃ nirodhaḥ saṃprajāyatetaṃ dṛṣṭyā mokṣamāpnoti yena tad vatsa badhyatetasmāt saṃviditaṃ sarvamiti saṃvinmayo bhavettathaiva kṣīṇavṛttiḥ syādapāne vilayaṃ gatebinduṣaṭkaparityāgācchāntabodhaḥ kṣaṇād bhavetdvādaśānte mahāśaktiḥ siddhairuktā sukhāgamepuryaṣṭaka vibhedepi tathaiva manaso layaḥstambhita prāṇavṛttaistu nirodhaḥ saṃprajāyatelīyamāne ratānando nistaraṅgaḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhavetānanda nirbharaṃ cittaṃ nivṛttiṃ labhate kṣaṇātp. 248b) sāvadhānasya tajjñānaṃ kṣīṇabodhaḥ prajāyatedṛśyānāṃ ṣāḍavādīnāṃ svalolāgre sthitiṃ kurumālatyādiṣu gandhāṃśca tathaiva paribhāvayetitthaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ yasya cittamātmani līyatekṛtā vāmana dattena svabodhodaryāmañjarī
